topics.name: Deployment
notes: - 将 agent 打包成容器镜像，配置通过环境变量注入，密钥使用密钥管理服务。
- LangGraph 应用可以用 langgraph.json 描述图的入口和依赖，再按官方文档的部署方案发布；也可以自己用 FastAPI 等框架封装。
- 使用健康检查、滚动发布和一键回滚；提示词、模型版本和代码一起做版本管理。
- 先灰度（小比例流量）再全量，并对比评估指标。
- checkpointer 所用数据库的结构迁移要和代码发布协同。

topics.name: Monitoring
notes: - 三类信号：日志、指标、trace。agent 还需要关注质量信号。
- 关键指标：延迟（P50/P95）、错误率、token 用量与成本、工具调用失败率、平均循环步数。
- 质量：用户反馈（点赞/点踩）、在线评估分数、人工抽检。
- 设置告警阈值，例如错误率突增或成本异常；用 trace 定位具体失败的请求。
- 把线上失败案例加入评估数据集，形成闭环。

questions.title: How should secrets such as API keys be provided to a deployed agent service?

options.text: Through environment variables or a secret manager

questions.explanation: Secrets must stay out of images and source control, and be rotatable without rebuilding.

questions.title: What is a canary (gradual) release?

options.text: Sending a small share of traffic to the new version and comparing metrics before a full rollout
Running the new version without monitoring

questions.explanation: A limited rollout reduces the blast radius of a regression in prompts, models or code.

questions.title: Which should be versioned together so that a release can be reproduced?
questions.explanation: Behavior depends on all three. Personal user data is not part of a release artifact.

questions.title: Which key of langgraph.json tells where the compiled graph object is defined?
questions.explanation: graphs maps a graph name to a 'file:variable' path. dependencies lists packages and env points to environment settings.

questions.title: Which metrics are worth monitoring for a production agent?

options.text: Number of Python files in the repository

questions.explanation: These reflect user experience, cost and reliability. Repository size says nothing about runtime behavior.

questions.title: Why track P95 latency instead of only the average?

options.text: The average hides slow requests that a meaningful share of users experience
P95 is always lower than the average

questions.explanation: P95 means 95% of requests are faster than this value, so it exposes tail latency, which agents with multiple steps often have.

questions.title: How can production failures be used to improve the agent over time?

options.text: Add the failing cases to the evaluation dataset and re-run evaluations after each fix
Ignore them until users complain twice

questions.explanation: Turning failures into regression tests closes the loop between monitoring and evaluation.
